originalFailuresResolved.failure: Initializer exact configured temperature versus a native round-trip slightly above it.
originalFailuresResolved.resolution: Re-enable fixture uses observed temperature + 0.001 K. Pure helper/reset retain exact-target assertions. No physical temperature tolerance or controller source changed.

originalFailuresResolved.failure: Historical sequence-3 replay did not enter an incidental hold under the new comfort controller.
originalFailuresResolved.resolution: Keep its entire unchanged original schedule with mandatory no-fault/energy/water/EOS envelope assertions. Add a distinct generic low-efficiency cold-source calling fixture that must enter a discharge hold, retain zero work, and freshly restart after real warm-boundary evolution plus minimum-off dwell.

originalFailuresResolved.failure: Historical sequence-16 room temperatures already exceed targets by 2.86–10.75 K, so the new thermostat correctly eliminates ordinary demand.
originalFailuresResolved.resolution: Explicitly migrate missing historical comfort-call fields in the test helper. Assert original satisfied saved state remains idle and conserved. Add a distinct renewed-call extension using only target edits; verify no stored-energy/water/configuration impulse, then require actual hot-source thermal hold, physical fan/store evolution, and fresh EOS recovery. Original checkpoint files are unchanged.

metadataFaultFix.change: When both advance and passive output reconstruction fail, stopped fallback zeros fanSpeedFraction and reports the restored accepted thermostatCalling latch.
metadataFaultFix.test: Backend callbacks fail after a prior accepted running interval with positive fan command; fraction, fan watts and flow stop while rooms, call history, ledgers and drive roll back.

reviewAgreement: Independent science reviewer agreed to the explicit historical-checkpoint migration and deliberate hot/cold protection coverage extensions before execution.
limitations: Thermostat, initialization, fan/UA and 95/5 allocation are declared generic controller assumptions, not manufacturer maps.
These focused gates supplement the separately pinned full Reference regression and 21-scenario robustness receipt.
